steps.action: On the existing canonical F-host only run docs/chatgpt_status/topography/shards/height_difference_2/automation/030_apply_attempt_020_existing_f_runner_recovery.ps1; preserve or start exactly one persistent canonical daemon and never create a second task or runner.
Verify the four canonical recovery/output receipts, persistent_daemon_count_after=1, a fresh heartbeat and the exact task/attempt/continuation claim before accepting any canonical progress.

For each BNG target query the Environment Agency National_LIDAR_Programme_Catalogues layer 0. If live point-query transport remains blocked, download the official National_LIDAR_Programme GeoJSON or GeoPackage coverage archive and perform the exact native EPSG:27700 intersection offline. Record only returned/intersected dtm_fn, tilename, survey id, flight dates, resolution, supplied and latest fields.

Query the official DTM Time Stamped Extents layer 0 for the exact native-BNG target when historic lineage is required; do not infer survey-specific transform or geoid from tile names or point-cloud records.
Resolve the current HMLR INSPIRE polygon for IDs 46058185, 39866294 and 62045430 in native BNG; retain the HMLR indicative-extent limitation and avoid web-map reprojection for the raster mask.

Use an XML-capable client on the persistent EA Composite DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 endpoint to obtain the real CoverageId, DescribeCoverage and GetCoverage output. Sample actual raster bytes within the native HMLR polygon, exclude NoData and retain ODN/EPSG:27700 provenance.

Discover the live Terrain50 product and version through the keyless OS Downloads API. Request product downloads with area=TQ and ASCII Grid and GML Grid format, then require actual archive bytes containing TQ39, TQ59 and TQ27 tile members rather than assuming file names.
Read each real Terrain50 tile metadata file for BNG/ODN and capture dates, then sample the documented 50m pixel centre. Treat Terrain50 only as secondary corroboration of the primary EA DTM sample.

Run the three EA versus Terrain50 numeric crosschecks, preserve source-specific accuracy scopes, then verify the port 8012 HTTP/DOM readback. Do not mark the manual action RESOLVED until recovery receipts, fresh heartbeat/claim and accepted exact outputs are all remotely verified.
